description: Spatial Planning, Urban Growth, and Flooding-Contrasting Urban Processes in Kigali and Kampala is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. PhD Research: Urban growth is a factor known to intensify local flooding. By orienting urban development, land use planning may contribute to reduce flood risk through regulatory constraints. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. Its tags are Social Sciences, spatial planning; urban growth; flooding; Kigali (Rwanda); Kampala (Uganda). The repository dates the deposit 2019; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
